product_metadata.title: CONBOLA Desk Fan, 11.8 Inch Quiet Bladeless Fan USB Desktop Rechargeable Fan, Small Portable Table Fan with 3 Cooling Speeds, Touch Control Personal Fan for Bedroom, Office, Home, Outdoor (White)
features: 【No Blade, More Safe】- Compared with the traditional desk fan, CONBOLA bladeless desk fan adopts the latest technology of built-in turbine blades, never worries about hurting fingers, and provides additional safety for children, elder or pets. This makes the desk fan suitable for anywhere like bedrooms, office, home and kitchen. Enjoy a self-made breeze while being safe!

【Lower Noise, More Serenity】- CONBOLA bladeless desk fan equips with high performance motor, adopts a unique air-duct, runs quietly with no annoying sound, and provided great cool air flow for bedroom or office,which provides the intimate silent care of your sweet dream and no need to worry about noise affecting work. Ideal choice for noise-sensitive people!

【USB Powered & Rechargeable Fan】- The USB fan has a 4400mAh battery, supports about 4.5-12 hours working time depending on different speed levels. Configured with Type-C cord, and it can be charged conveniently with USB devices such as computer, laptop, car charger, power bank and more USB enabled devices. Whether you are indoor or outdoor, the fan can provided great cool air!

【Touch Control with Adjustable 3 Speeds】- 3 wind speeds (high,Medium,low) can be adjusted by one SMART TOUCH button, and the low speed is designed for sleeping, the medium mode can better relieve the stuffiness for office, and the high-speed mode can quickly take away your torridness. Let you select the level that's best for your cooling needs! Perfect for any small-medium space where you need comfortable cooling airflow.

【The Exquisitest Gift Choose】- Unique and elegant shape, high-quality and durable material avoid the embarrassment of cheap looking gift. In the hot summer, provided this bladeless fan as a gift for you, family or friend to earn brownie points, the sultry summer will bring you the irresistible coolness!
